name: Triplanar Texture Projection
definition: Projects a 2D texture onto a 3D surface using three orthogonal projections (XY, XZ, YZ) weighted by the surface normal's absolute components to avoid texture stretching.
summary: Triplanar Texture Projection maps 2D textures onto 3D surfaces by blending samples from three orthogonal planes based on surface normals, preventing distortion on complex geometry unlike single-axis planar mapping.
